Maya (Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: a few crisp clarifications for teams working on GTM and roadmap. @Ari @Sam can you keep answers short?
Ari (CEO): Yep — short answers.
Maya (Product): 1) Short elevator line for external comms vs technical docs?
Ari (CEO): External: 'Predictable, production-grade LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.' Technical: 'High-throughput inference runtime with latency SLOs, KV caching, and automated fallbacks.'
Maya (Product): 2) Where is our moat — model selection or serving/ops?
Sam (CTO): Serving & ops. Models change; customers pay for predictable latency and cost. We pick vetted models but our differentiation is runtime + observability + hybrid deployment options.
Diego (Sales): Should sales push benchmarks or customer outcomes first?
Ari (CEO): Outcomes first, then benchmarks for technical buyers.
Maya (Product): 3) Immediate roadmap items that materially help close rates for Dedicated?
Sam (CTO): Autoscaling SLA docs, onboarding checklist for security teams, and a TCO comparison widget.
Ruth (Legal): Note: sales needs an exportable security checklist for prospects.
Maya (Product): 4) If a team proposes defaulting to a higher-quality but higher-cost model for Dedicated, who signs off?
Sam (CTO): Eng lead + ML infra + product + assigned AE; require perf and cost delta in PRD.
Maya (Product): 5) Metrics leadership is watching next quarter?
Ari (CEO): Hosted conversion rate, Dedicated deal velocity, median tail latency.
Maya (Product): Thanks all — I'll circulate a one-pager summary and PRD template.
